stories.title: Centrumlinks schuift Raphaël Glucksmann naar voren als Franse presidentskandidaat

en.title: Centre-left advances Raphaël Glucksmann as French presidential candidate
en.summary: Raphaël Glucksmann won a primary vote with 66 percent of over 120,000 online votes to become the centre-left bloc's presidential candidate for France's upcoming election. The 46-year-old MEP will attempt to unite the fragmented left-wing camp in his campaign.

stories.title: Luchthaven in Riyad blijft voor passagiers gesloten na Houthi-aanvallen

en.title: Airport in Riyadh remains closed to passengers following Houthi attacks
en.summary: An airport in Riyadh has suspended passenger operations due to attacks carried out by Houthi forces.

stories.title: Trump moet van rechter stoppen met tv-campagne betaald met belastinggeld

en.title: Trump must stop TV campaign funded with taxpayer money, judge rules
en.summary: A federal judge in New York ordered the Trump administration to immediately cease broadcasting campaign advertisements paid for with public funds.

stories.title: Albert Heijn en Etos getroffen door IT-incident, boodschappen niet bezorgd

en.title: Albert Heijn and Etos affected by IT incident, deliveries disrupted
en.summary: An information technology failure has impacted Albert Heijn and Etos, resulting in failed delivery of groceries to customers.

stories.title: Video | Bewakingsbeelden tonen aanval op luchthaven Saoedi-Arabië

en.title: Video | Security footage shows attack on Saudi Arabia airport
en.summary: Security camera footage has captured an attack on an airport in Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Storing bij Albert Heijn door 'IT-incident': geen bezorging en oude prijzen in winkel

en.title: Outage at Albert Heijn due to 'IT incident': no deliveries and old prices in store
en.summary: Albert Heijn, Etos, and Gall & Gall websites and apps went offline Sunday evening following an IT incident. The supermarket temporarily halted deliveries and disabled several systems.

stories.title: Franse sociaaldemocraten schuiven Europarlementariër Raphaël Glucksmann naar voren voor presidentsverkiezingen

en.title: French social democrats put forward Member of European Parliament Raphaël Glucksmann for presidential election
en.summary: French social democrats have nominated European Parliament member Raphaël Glucksmann as their candidate for the upcoming presidential election.

stories.title: Saudi-Arabië zal 'stevig terugslaan' na Houthi-aanval op luchthaven Riyad

en.title: Saudi Arabia will 'strike back hard' after Houthi attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: Houthi forces struck Saudi Arabia's Riyadh airport, prompting international concern about escalation. Saudi Arabia pledges a strong response while fighting continues between Houthis and Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen.

stories.title: Na aanval op luchthaven Riad dreigen ook de VS zich in de strijd tegen de Houthi’s te mengen – met mogelijk ‘desastreuze gevolgen’ voor de regio

en.title: After attack on Riyadh airport, US threatens to join fight against Houthis – with possible 'disastrous consequences' for the region
en.summary: A Houthi attack on Riyadh airport killed twelve people and wounded over three hundred. Crown Prince Mohammed bin-Salman faces a difficult situation, which an expert suggests he created himself.

stories.title: ‘Ik zag de gewonden voor mijn ogen liggen’: zowel ravage als internationale verontwaardiging zijn groot na zware Houthi-aanval op luchthaven Riyad

en.title: 'I saw the wounded in front of my eyes': both damage and international outrage are severe after heavy Houthi attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: A major Houthi attack on Riyadh airport caused significant damage and casualties, triggering widespread international condemnation.

stories.title: Luchthaven in Saoedi-Arabië opnieuw getroffen door projectiel, na dodelijke aanval zaterdag

en.title: Airport in Saudi Arabia hit again by projectile, after deadly attack Saturday
en.summary: A Saudi Arabian airport was struck by a projectile following a deadly attack that occurred the previous day.

stories.title: "IT incident" knocks out site, app of Albert Heijn & subsidiary brands; No online orders

en.title: IT incident knocks out site, app of Albert Heijn & subsidiary brands; No online orders
en.summary: Websites and apps for Albert Heijn and its subsidiary brands Etos and Gall & Gall went offline on Sunday evening due to an IT incident, preventing online orders.
